summary: Frontend testing for breathwork sound loudness tuning. Verified new default gain values are applied per sound profile. Sound switching works correctly without overlap or silence.
critical_code_review_comments: Sound tuning values verified in useBreathworkEngine.js:
- Whale (lines 226-273): setMasterGain(0.27), base freq 88Hz (deeper), overtone at 176Hz with gain 0.022, LFO 0.048Hz depth 32
- Birds (lines 294-312): setMasterGain(0.27), chirp gain peaks at 0.13 (louder), freq range 1700-3500Hz (brighter)
- Fire (lines 190-219): setMasterGain(0.31), crackle gain peaks at 0.12 (stronger), highpass 1300-2500Hz
- Dolphin (lines 274-293): setMasterGain(0.25), call gain peaks at 0.11 (stronger), freq range 1100-1800Hz
stopSound() properly stops all ambient sources before starting new sound - no overlap
playSelectedSound() calls stopSound() before initAmbientSound() - verified no silence gaps
test_credentials: No auth needed for breathwork page
